_readme: Communities shown on the website's wall, in the order they appear.
This file is hand-curated on purpose: a server is listed only when one of
its admins has asked to be, never automatically because the bot happens to
be installed there. Requests come in through the 'Add my community' issue
template, which carries the consent checkbox.
Fields — name is required, the rest are optional:
name      Full name as its members would write it.
location  Campus, city, or country. Shown under the name.
initials  Monogram for the crest. Derived from the name when omitted.
logo      Path under docs/, e.g. 'img/communities/yorku.png'. Replaces the
monogram. Square images look best; only use one you've been given
url       Optional link — their site or a public invite. Makes the card a link.
After editing, run `make site` to regenerate the wall in docs/index.html.
